description: Before recommending a practice you learned in training, check whether it still holds: a curated, dated register of development and AI practices (still valid, superseded by what, anti-pattern, unnecessary since, or depends on the case), each with its evidence and how sure it is. Give `since` (your knowledge cutoff) to get only what changed after it. If the register has no entry, it says so instead of guessing — no entry means not reviewed, not "fine".

area.description: Without topic: list every entry of this area (id, title, verdict; ~2,000 tokens) to scan it yourself

since.description: Your knowledge cutoff: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

topic.description: What to check, in English: e.g. "chain of thought prompting", "jwt in localStorage"

name: practice_check
